mcqs.question: Which economy secured the first position in the Global Innovation Index 2026 with a score of 66.7?
mcqs.explanation: Switzerland ranked first in the Global Innovation Index 2026 with a score of 66.7. India, China and Bengaluru are associated with other results in the index, not the top global position.

mcqs.keyword: State rank by number of factories
mcqs.question: According to the Annual Survey of Industries 2024–25, which State ranked seventh in the number of factories, with 13,937 factories?
mcqs.explanation: Telangana ranked seventh with 13,937 factories in the Annual Survey of Industries 2024–25. Andhra Pradesh ranked sixth, while Maharashtra and Gujarat occupied higher positions in the ranking.
